constraints: No resend of expansion-021 or any completed episode.
No rewriting old scores, ledger events, fixed denominators, failure records or unknown usage.

Current controller must continue rejecting the retained new stop unless a separately reviewed explicit prospective amendment is introduced after the user decision.
Any later new usage unknown or core stop stops dispatch again.

No controller-selected hidden fallback, Flash model, controller-initiated resend, or automatic expansion to significance. Gateway-internal behavior is reported separately and is not attested by this rule.
Read-only route metadata is not proof that the failing provider is healthy.
The 139-reservation proposal does not establish acceptance or guarantee all project criteria can close.
